basic_info.description: Welcome to this fully detached 4-bedroom 2-bath corner home in the highly desirable Crocker Amazon neighborhood. Owned by one family, this property retains its original condition and ready for your personal updates. The upper-level features 2 bedrooms 1 bath, an inviting L-shaped dining and living room with a fireplace and a spacious eat-in kitchen. The lower level includes 2 additional bedrooms 1 bath and convenient side-by-side garages. Double paned windows and hardwood floor throughout upstairs. Low-maintenance backyard offers a peaceful retreat for relaxation and quiet enjoyment. With easy access to Highways 101 and 280 and less than a mile from Balboa Park BART, this home offers prime commuting options and proximity to nearby shops, restaurants, cafes, parks, and more. Bring your vision to this classic home and make it your own!
